messages:
maria: Quick sync — big strategic prospect is pushing for Feature X but contract requires SOC2 Type II + ISO scope. They want launch in 6 weeks. Do we prioritize certification runway or shipping the feature behind a contract that limits use? :eyes:
priya: Need numbers. What's revenue ARR if we win now vs probability and timeline for cert?
alex: FYI sales: this deal is ~ $600k ARR first year, expansion likely. They told us SOC2 will speed procurement, but they also want feature X live for POC.
dina: Security POV: SOC2 Type II is non-trivial — controls, evidence, continuous monitoring. For Type II timeline realistically 10–12 weeks if we prioritize and pull auditors in now. ISO adds more scope.
chad: Engineering check — feature X is ~4 sprint work for core + infra changes for secrets handling. If we rush, risk tech debt + rework for audit controls.
priya: Thinking in RICE to compare: impact ~ 8 (deal + reference), reach smallish now, confidence 0.6, effort 5 sprints. For SOC2: impact maybe 6 (platform trust), reach broad, confidence 0.8, effort 8 sprints.
maria: Can we split scope? Ship a limited surface of Feature X (no cross-tenant data) behind EA-only flag and run the POC under strict SSO + contract clause. Meanwhile we start SOC2 for infra controls.
dina: Splitting helps. We need minimum baseline controls for the EA rollout: inventory, access reviews, basic logging, defined incident response. Those map to SOC2 common criteria and are feasible in 3–4 weeks if we divert a couple of engs.
chad: If we do that, ask: can we avoid adding new persistent data stores or cross-tenant writes? Keep everything ephemeral and encrypted. That reduces audit scope.
priya: Proposal: sequence -> 1) Ship feature X limited to EA + contract + SSO (3 weeks) 2) Start SOC2 sprint push in parallel (start week 1) 3) GA after Type II achieved or 2nd-quarter rollback if controls not met.
alex: Sales supports sequence if legal writes strong contractual protections and we get the POC. Will push client to accept EA pilot clause.
dina: Two risks: (1) auditors may still want evidence across feature code paths if we ship; (2) resource contention could lengthen cert. We should log these in the risk register.
sre-bot: deploy: staging->prod feature-flagged for client-acct-123 at 2025-11-02T09:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
chad: Also recommend a short RICE table so execs can see tradeoffs quickly. I'll drop numbers in PRD.
maria: Good. Action items: Priya draft RICE + rollout sequence by EOD. Dina list mandatory baseline controls + estimate. Chad to confirm engineering split and blockers. Alex to get client sign-off on EA pilot legal language. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
